title: Features
body: A unit of product work under an Initiative. An HQDM `activity`. Rolls up effort and progress from its Tasks and doc count from its Docs.

title: Points
body: Estimated size of the feature (a `physical_quantity`). Stored, set by the team.

title: Effort (hours)
body: Sum of `hours` across this feature's Tasks — a rollup that moves the instant any task's hours change.

title: Tasks done
body: Sum of each Task's `doneFlag` (a rollup of a computed column) — how many of the feature's tasks are complete.

title: Progress
body: taskDone ÷ taskCount (a computed column over two rollups); 0 when there are no tasks. This is computed-from-rollup.

title: Shipped points
body: This feature's `points` if its status is shipped, else 0 — a computed column the Initiative rolls up.

title: Feature → Tasks
body: Each Task names its feature; this relation carries the effort/progress rollups.

title: Feature → Docs
body: Each Doc names the feature it documents; the feature's docCount rolls up over it.
